method: Read-only EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, TIMING OFF), 100 active/upcoming/postponed/unknown auction_sales ordered by id, materialized sample. Compare one deadline call with raw_payload versus raw_payload || '{}'::jsonb.
interpretation: The reversed warm pass also improves; repeated TOAST access inside the retention function is avoidable. This is a bounded production read benchmark, not the full worker throughput.
